state.title: naoqi_rest

part.text:
The robot followed the corridor to the red wall and is now stopped in front of it. It's about 0.75 m from the wall by the sonar, and the wall fills the camera view. I called `rest`, so the robot is crouched with its motors off.

The walk had several corners, and the robot stopped for obstacles a few times along the way. It never fell, and the battery is at 99%.
